design_parameters.enrich_notes: Ohio WQv uses 0.75 in precipitation (P) in WQv = C × 0.75 × A / 12; NPDES requires +20% WQv for sediment. Extended-detention drawdown varies by pond type (dry ED 48 hr; wet/wetland ED 24 hr; general WQv drainage cited as 24–48 hr). Bioretention: Ohio EPA minimum 40 hr drawdown; planting soil ≥2.5 ft; ponding generally <6 in, up to 12 in; length:width generally >2:1; 4 ft required (2 ft recommended) separation to seasonal high groundwater. Infiltration trench: soil K 0.52–2.5 in/hr; WQv drain 24–48 hr; ≥2 ft to SHWT/bedrock at trench bottom. Sand filter: 40 hr total design drawdown. Wet pool mean depth 3–6 ft; wetland pool depths generally 6–18 in (avg 6–12 in). Corpus is statewide Ohio Rainwater and Land Development manual used as Toledo MS4 reference.
